Staff rotas, good news after closing
We write to travelers

Urgent Notice for Companion Animal Travel

Travelers need to check animal papers and crate setup before they head to the airport. Aurelia Skyways wants safe, calm, and steady companion travel, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk is ready to help with the basics.

If your trip includes a reptile, bring the right fee proof and keep all papers with you. <<FACT F060>> Staff should also watch for crate latches, clean bedding, and water access, because a small miss can turn into a serious delay. Keep your animal close and follow crew directions without pushing back.

For cats, make sure the health certificate is current and easy to show at the desk. <<FACT F079>> Do not wait until boarding to sort this out, since checks can slow down fast when documents are missing. If anything looks off, fix it before you travel.

Please go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk now for help before departure.
